hebrewText: וְ/אִם כֹּ֨ה יֹאמְר֜וּ עֲל֤וּ עָלֵ֨י/נוּ֙ וְ/עָלִ֔ינוּ כִּֽי נְתָנָ֥/ם יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יָדֵ֑/נוּ וְ/זֶה לָּ֖/נוּ הָ/אֽוֹת

tokens.bdb: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
tokens.kjv: (and, can-, doubtless, if, that) (not), [phrase] but, either, [phrase] except, [phrase] more(-over if, than), neither, nevertheless, nor, oh that, or, [phrase] save (only, -ing), seeing, since, sith, [phrase] surely (no more, none, not), though, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] unless, [phrase] verily, when, whereas, whether, while, [phrase] yet.

tokens.bdb: properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now
tokens.kjv: also, here, + hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (on) this (manner, side, way, way and that way), + mean while, yonder.
